newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon and Gulf Bank 1996 unaudited results. [CORRECTED 09:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lebanon and Gulf Bank 1996 unaudited results. [CORRECTED 09:50 GMT]

text.p: Lebanon and Gulf Bank said on Monday its profits almost doubled in 1996 and it also reported big increases in its assets, customer deposits and capital in 1996.
Net income rose to 20.15 million Lebanese pounds from 10.97 million in 1995, the bank said in its unaudited balance sheet published in Beirut newspapers.
Lebanon and Gulf Bank, which ranked 19th among Lebanon's 82 banks in size of customer deposits in 1995, said its assets rose to 522.743 billion pounds from 390.646 billion in 1995.
